purpose: technical single-world geometry only, never final sprites

settings.fixedIdentity: Three-place slatted bench, BACK on+Y, sitting FRONT on-Y. Tall attached course-map panel ALWAYS at physicalRIGHT+X. Panel FRONT has map, BACK bare wood; do not duplicate a front corner.
settings.identity_policy: One unchanging object state; fixed source-side details; no copied corner or mirrored source. Native generation/review remains separate.

coordinate_system: metres; front y=-depth/2; right x=+width/2; z up; ONE model rotated0/90/180/270 about z
depth_handling: orthographic triangle rasterization, barycentric per-pixel depth, keep nearest; no average-depth painter guess
svg_form: self-contained exact technical z-buffer raster; editable full world mesh is stored separately
